limitations: The tested domain is the specified discrete VTG grid at 300 K and 50 mV drain bias, with a 0..1 V control sweep and four small artificial targets. Continuous geometry, other bias/temperature and Monte Carlo tails are unqualified.
MG is an exploratory extraction coordinate, not BSIM VTH0, an exact replication of author extraction code, or a replacement for released finite-difference gm/gds.
Isolation is demonstrated for electrically independent twins sharing ideal bias sources. Connected-circuit bias coupling and general arbitrary hierarchies are not qualified.
Hart measured beta remains blocked separately for N/P. No IO beta, source-calibrated statistics, foundry correlation or reliability claim follows.
Installed OpenVAF differs from the repository pin. The doctor hard-codes that pin in generated metadata; its smoke success is not exact pinned-environment qualification.
No source paper, screenshot, extracted full text, compiled binary or raw simulator output is committed.

protocol.coordinates: N: U=VGS, P: U=VSG; retain signed i(Vda),i(Vdb) separately; MG differentiates |i(Vd)|
protocol.extraction: CubicSpline terminal-current differentiation, interior maximum; beta=gm_max/|VDS|; Vth=Ustar-|ID|/gm_max-|VDS|/2
protocol.targets: All four combinations of +/-10 mV VTH_MG and +/-2% relative BETA_MG; artificial deterministic inputs, not process sigmas

review_and_repairs: Original offline suite: 34 PASSED; original real runner reported success for both polarities. Its stage coupling and weak readback-only rejection could conceal failures.
Application/acquisition is now independent from MG; both polarities and every grid/target retain independent status. No extractor equation or tolerance changed.
Controls require demonstrated rejection/reset mechanisms; reset reads actual nonzero knobs before reparse. Missing output, unrelated solver errors and timeouts cannot pass controls.
Persist timeout requests and partial logs, expected/observed readback, signed curves, source/tool hashes, inventories, per-stage timings and process counts.
Explicit ngspice num_threads=1 repairs observed system-spinit contention. Initial partial expansion is retained as interrupted, and all geometries were rerun.
The finite-difference inversion algorithm is unchanged; numerical_core changes only organize imports, remove redundant parentheses and replace map with an equivalent generator.
The final separate suite has 39 synthetic/analytic tests; stronger mechanism tests replace the former permissive readback-only checks.

run_accounting.count_scope: Experiment circuit processes; excludes --version, doctor and repository-regression subprocesses.
run_accounting.wall_time_note: Minimum run followed by eight independent expansion drivers; summed driver times are not elapsed wall time.

smallest_full_v5_contract_proposal: Require a separately authorized goal. Limit the first implementation to optional VTG N/P instance-local research variation, preserving Benchmark v2/native variation, released model bytes and result semantics.

Freeze a distinct versioned MG coordinate, signed terminal data, bias/geometry domain, peak rejection and refinement criteria. Start from the tested discrete domain; require evidence before interpolation or expansion.

Specify the full two-observable DELVTO/ln(MULU0) mapping with per-polarity signs, cross terms, finite increments, scaled conditioning, explicit raw bounds, residual checks, fresh processes and verified hierarchy readback. Fail closed without clipping or resampling.

Keep measured statistics behind a separate source gate: pinned process/source, coherent units and pair/individual normalization, geometry/extraction/temperature transfer, uncertainty/covariance decisions and an independent total-current-mismatch cross-check. Original Hart N/P beta stays blocked; an alternative needs its own qualification.

Only after source approval define a small circuit and fixed sample-count/tail workload. The four artificial targets do not establish +/-6 sigma support. IO transfer, other statistical modes and absent statistics remain separate decisions.
Before claiming the full reference environment, verify the actual compiler build against the repository pin and correct misleading hard-coded provenance under separate implementation authorization.

source.snapshot_semantics: The executed code/contract/model bytes are hash-bound above. Maintenance validation records its pre-evidence-authoring worktree snapshot. Findings and STATUS are subsequent result-only additions, not unrecorded changes to the executed experiment.
